title: Editorial fact-check and copyedit pipeline
description: Validates claims, edits language and structure, and runs a final publication-readiness gate.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: editorial-factcheck-copyedit
  title: Editorial fact-check and copyedit pipeline
  description: Validates claims, edits language and structure, and runs a final publication-readiness gate.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Publish accurate, clear, and style-compliant content.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - publisher-approval
  nodes:
    - id: draft
      kind: input
      name: Draft, sources, and style guide
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - document
          - sources
          - styleGuide
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: factcheck
      kind: agent
      name: Fact-check draft
      role: Editorial fact checker
      prompt: Verify factual claims, quotations, dates, figures, and citations. Flag unsupported or misleading statements.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: copyedit
      kind: agent
      name: Copyedit draft
      role: Copyeditor
      prompt: Improve clarity, grammar, structure, style, and accessibility while preserving intended meaning. Return tracked
        edits.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: proof
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Publication readiness gate
      role: Senior editor
      prompt: Return passed only when factual issues are resolved and editorial standards are met.
      config:
        threshold: 0.95
    - id: revision-loop
      kind: loop
      name: Bounded revision loop
      config:
        body:
          - factcheck
          - copyedit
          - proof
        exitCondition: proof.passed == true
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: publisher-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Publisher approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Publication-ready document and editorial log
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: draft
      to: factcheck
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: draft
      to: copyedit
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: factcheck
      to: proof
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: copyedit
      to: proof
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: proof
      to: publisher-approval
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e6
      from: proof
      to: revision-loop
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e7
      from: publisher-approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: revision-loop-exit
      from: revision-loop
      to: publisher-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: revision-loop-exhausted
      from: revision-loop
      to: publisher-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
